## Intended function

Describe what the circuit must do and its expected supply and interfaces.

## References

Link or attach schematics, datasheets, classroom material, or example boards. Distinguish authoritative facts from visual inspiration.

## Constraints

State board size, layer preference, assembly method, package preference, trace/clearance limits, connectors, and fabrication method.

## Acceptance evidence

List the expected ERC, DRC, connectivity, render, and fabrication checks.
